identity.title: Retain Affine Transform Tool Partial after concrete owner audit

origin.summary: The user requested that Partial refactoring continue in scheduled cycles and that each remaining Partial be structurally reviewed rather than mechanically deleted or split.

state.current_summary: AffineTransformToolWpfView.xaml.cs를 no-change 구조 감사로 재확인했다. View Partial은 required XAML/controller adapter로 유지되고, AffineTransformToolViewModel, generic property controller, result presenter, preview executor, factory/composition, registry/base가 state, binding, result, algorithm, persistence, creation, lifetime을 각각 소유한다. 독립 state/lifetime/test seam이 없어 production split은 만들지 않았으며, Debug/Release contract/build와 Affine WPF smoke가 통과했다.

objective.summary: Audit AffineTransformToolWpfView's Partial structure and retain it only if existing concrete owners already provide property, preview, result, persistence, binding, and lifetime boundaries without a new split.
constraints: Work only in C:\Git\2D\Dev; do not modify C:\Git\2D\Original.
Do not add a service, interface, manager, wrapper, forwarding Partial, or ViewModel split for file length alone.
Preserve AffineTransformToolWpfView XAML names, Learn contract, property/result/test facades, preview path, persistence, and DisposeView lifetime.
Keep test outputs and evidence under D:\OpenVisionLab-TestData\OpenVisionLab_Dev.
Do not commit, push, tag, release, deploy, or mutate the Original repository.

criteria.text: The proof report records current/intended owners, caller path, mutable-state writer, lifetime owner, binding/public/test contract, shortest reading order, and the reason no production split is justified.

The source contract proves that the View Partial has no direct persistence/file-dialog/algorithm coupling and that existing ViewModel, generic controller, result presenter, preview, factory/composition, registry, and base lifetime owners are wired.
Focused Debug/Release contracts and builds plus Affine WPF smoke and dynamic monitor geometry pass; broader theme/DPI/input/camera/SDK/GPU/native runtime remains explicitly unverified.

evidence.observation: AffineTransformToolWpfView remains a required XAML/controller adapter. Existing ViewModel, generic property controller, result presenter, preview executor, factory/composition, registry, and base View provide concrete property, binding/test, result, algorithm, persistence/creation, registration, and lifetime owners. The View has no direct settings store, dialog, System.IO, OpenCvSharp, or algorithm construction coupling.
AffineTransformPartialBoundaryContract passed 9/9 in Debug and Release. VisionRecipeRunnerSmoke Debug and Release builds passed with 0 warnings/errors.

PipelineViewerScreenshotSmoke Debug build passed with 0 warnings/errors. wpf_shell_host_affine_transform_tool WPF precheck passed with check=OK and layout/text/internal counts zero, producing a fresh screenshot. Sequential dynamic monitor probing recorded one DISPLAY2 1920x1080 monitor and one intersecting visible smoke window. Broader UI and native matrices remain unverified.

events.summary: AffineTransformToolWpfView Partial은 required XAML/controller adapter이고 기존 ViewModel/generic controller/result/preview/factory/base owners가 독립 책임과 lifetime을 이미 제공한다. 새 seam 없이 분리하면 wrapper나 중복 상태가 되므로 no-change로 유지한다.
PL-0043의 세 completion criteria가 현재 증거로 충족되어 resolved로 닫는다. 전체 theme/DPI/input, native dialog, camera/SDK/GPU 및 long-running native runtime은 이 slice의 검증 범위가 아니다.

The Affine Transform Partial retained-owner audit found no independent boundary that justified a production split; focused source/build/WPF evidence was recorded. Do not reopen without a new requirement, reproducible defect, failed criterion, or changed dependency/lifetime boundary.
